Walk in Interview for appointment of one Security Guard Purely on Daily
Wage against leave Vacancy until February 2024
Applications are being accepted for the position of one Security Guard at the Panjab University Regional
Center Muktsar, which will pay a daily wage against a leave vacancy until February, 2024.
Interviews will be held with candidates who have turned in properly completed application forms in
response to the aforementioned notice of advertisement after was posted at the Panjab University Regional
Center in Sri Muktsar Sahib. The application form is available on the Panjab University website at
http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php, and it must be filled out.
According to DC rates, the honorarium mentioned above is.
Note: Panjab University, Chandigarh's appointment policies shall be followed for the aforementioned
position.
The schedule will follow the guidelines below:
The candidates should bring all their original certificates and other relevant documents along with the duly
filled application forms and attested copies of all the certificates/ documents (Two copies each) and two
passport size photographs.
Minimum qualification is as per UGC norms.
1.10th Standard Passed.
2. Preference will be given to Ex-Service Man as per P.U rules.
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for the Interview.
